name: rasa.module.mode.release
description: The release mode: role-release-captain + module-releases, loaded together as one named Element set.

rasa.note: Example mode Element (galt ADR 0071; tenant ADR 2026-10-28-one-role-list D5). A mode is a pure composition declaration (canon's recipe kind): mode.json lists member Elements by name+ref; it carries no prompt.md, settings.json or skills of its own — everything it contributes comes from its members. Applying it (`galt mode set <session> mode-release`) replaces the session's whole loaded-Elements list with the resolved members, not an add to whatever was loaded before.
